**Protocol 1 — gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON REST)**
`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108` — `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` registers MemoService onto the grpc-gateway mux (generated gateway code lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`).

**Protocol 2 — Connect RPC (browser clients, replaces grpc-web)**
`server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40` — `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)` wraps MemoService as a Connect handler, registered into the Connect mux.

Both wrappers are invoked from `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (gateway mux mounted at `/api/v1/*`, Connect mux mounted at `/memos.api.v1.*`), and the underlying service is defined in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:17`.

**Proto definition:**
`/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:17` — `service MemoService { ... }`

The codebase (usememos/memos) does **not** use a plain `grpc.NewServer()` + `RegisterMemoServiceServer(...)` call anywhere in application code — `RegisterMemoServiceServer` only exists as a generated function (`proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go:439`) that is never invoked. Instead, MemoService is actually served over these **two** protocols:

### 1. grpc-gateway (REST/JSON over HTTP)
File: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108`
```go
if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
    return err
}
```
This is inside the `(s *APIV1Service) RegisterGateway(ctx context.Context, echoServer *echo.Echo) error` method (starts at `v1.go:65`), which builds a `runtime.NewServeMux` from `grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2` and registers all services (Instance, Auth, User, **Memo**, Attachment, AI, Shortcut, IdentityProvider) as in-process handlers translating HTTP/JSON to the Go service implementation.

### 2. Connect protocol (connectrpc.com/connect — supports gRPC, gRPC-Web, and Connect-over-HTTP in one handler)
File: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:39` (inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`, method starts at line 31)
```go
wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```
This registers the generated Connect handler (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`) onto an `http.ServeMux` via the `wrap()` helper (`connect_handler.go:51`). `NewConnectServiceHandler` (constructor at `connect_handler.go:26`) wraps `*APIV1Service` so both the gateway and Connect paths share the same underlying implementation.

**Summary of the two protocols and files:**
| Protocol | Registration call | File:Line |
|---|---|---|
| grpc-gateway (HTTP/JSON REST) | `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` | `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108` |
| Connect (connectrpc.com/connect, gRPC/gRPC-Web/Connect) | `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)` | `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:39` |

Both are wired together from `RegisterGateway`/`RegisterConnectHandlers`, which are called during server setup (see `server/server.go`).</result>
